welcome.title: XClaw
welcome.subtitle: Your sidekick is ready. You ask, I start. Endless possibilities await.
welcome.executionDesc: Drop in the goal, files, and constraints. I will take it from this desk and start moving.

welcome.continuationPrompt: Continue this work from the current session, model, and context:
